scenes.title_cn: 核心：二郎腿你一定拍过，但你一定不知…
scenes.title_en: Core: you've done the crossed-legs pose, b…
scenes.context: 膝盖侧放是二郎腿出片关键。
sentences: 二郎腿你一定拍过，但你一定不知道这个技巧。
You've done the crossed-legs pose, but you don't know this trick.
crossed-legs pose（二郎腿）
只要把膝盖侧过来放，就能轻轻松松出片。
Just angle the knee to the side and the shot looks effortless.
angle the knee（膝盖侧放）
scenes.speak: You've done the crossed-legs pose, but you don't know this trick. Just angle the knee to the side and the shot looks effortless.

scenes.title_cn: 腿型调整：前腿太显壮了？你可以放弃前…
scenes.title_en: Leg shape fixes: front leg too heavy? Skip…
scenes.context: 换腿交叉方式+拉长身段。
sentences: 放弃前腿搭后腿，改用后腿来搭前腿，看起来瘦多了。
Skip front-over-back and cross the back leg over the front—much slimmer.
back leg over front（后腿搭前腿）
腿好像短了点，没关系，身子拉长一点就好了。
Legs look a bit short—just lengthen the torso.
lengthen the torso（拉长身段）
最好再加个慵懒的感觉。
Best to add a lazy, relaxed vibe.
lazy vibe（慵懒感）
scenes.speak: Skip front-over-back and cross the back leg over the front—much slimmer. Legs look a bit short—just lengthen the torso. Best to add a lazy, relaxed vibe.

scenes.title_cn: 正面与风格：正面拍怎么办？也好办——…
scenes.title_en: Front view and styles: facing the lens? Ea…
sentences: 正面拍就把小腿伸出来，脚尖转正。
Face the lens by extending the lower leg and turning the toes forward.
extend the lower leg（伸出小腿）
韩系一点你就分开放，端庄一点你就并拢。
Korean style: legs apart; demure: legs together.
apart or together（分开或并拢）
scenes.speak: Face the lens by extending the lower leg and turning the toes forward. Korean style: legs apart; demure: legs together.

practice: Angle the knee to the side when crossing legs.
Cross the back leg over the front for slimness.
Lengthen the torso when legs look short.
Extend the lower leg and turn the toes forward.
pitfalls: Cross the back leg over the front instead.
前腿搭后腿显壮，后腿搭前腿显瘦。
Let the legs look too short.
Face the lens with cramped legs.
Extend the lower leg and turn the toes forward.
正面坐姿伸出小腿脚尖转正。
Use the same style for every vibe.
Apart for Korean style, together for demure.
韩系分开放，端庄就并拢。
shifts: 用 crossed-legs pose（二郎腿）、angle the knee（膝盖侧放）
用 back leg over front（后腿搭前腿）、extend the lower leg（伸小腿）
用 lazy vibe（慵懒感）、Korean style（韩系）、demure（端庄）
